global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and a single nori sheet resting atop. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it sits on a red surface under bright, even lighting.

regions.background: The table is a smooth, solid red surface with subtle light reflections and faint texture variations.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue and green geometric patterns and Chinese characters along its rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.spoon: A dark, glossy spoon with a curved bowl and textured surface, reflecting light subtly.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly curled, uneven surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows translucent, tender texture with visible fat marbling and slightly curled edges.
